evidence: query_aware_fusion beats fixed_hybrid on held-out TEST MRR (0.7895 vs 0.7856) and R@5 (0.8958 vs 0.8942).
On VAL, fixed_hybrid is slightly ahead — expected because hybrid weights were tuned on VAL MRR.
Pair-level LR/RF query-aware interactions do NOT beat non-adaptive counterparts on full-split; they also lag fixed hybrid — pool10 classification transfers poorly to full ranking.
Ablation (val): removing semantic features hurts most; removing identifier features improves LR full-split MRR (I can act as noise outside the 10-pool).
SBERT alone is strong; TF-IDF alone is weaker; hybrid of L+I+S is best among non-learned systems.
